messages:
patrick (prod): Heads-up: we're making Private v2.2 Beta available to Wave-2 customers next Mon (2026-04-06). Key highlights: optional FIPS-mode toggle for runtime, audit-log bundle export endpoint, and telemetry sampling default now 0.1% (customer opt-in for verbose). Please run the preflight and sign the attestation where required. Link: https://go/internal/private-v2-2-beta (internal).

marta (support): Can you confirm which customers are Wave-2? I'll prep the readiness sheet and customer emails.

patrick (prod): Wave-2 spreadsheet is in the shared drive. Support needs to add a column for "attestation signed" and another for "FIPS target appliance".

kevin (sales): For customers asking about FIPS-mode: enablement is no-cost, but extended audit log retention is a billable add-on. I'll coordinate with billing for opt-ins.

opsbot: rollout-manager: Rollout draft created for wave-2 start=3349994000 window=7200s owner=@patrick id=rollout-334999 :spiral_calendar:

patrick (prod): Maintenance window: 01:00-03:00 UTC. Rollback uses snapshot + feature-toggle revert. GA hold if >3 critical preflight failures across the wave.

devon (eng-runtime): Notes for Eng: FIPS-mode is a runtime flag (safe-paths only) that disables non-approved crypto paths. We added a runtime check and a short diag: 
```
# preflight fips check
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/diag -d '{"check":"fips"}' | jq .status
```
If the check returns "FAIL", agent will not enable FIPS-mode. Also added audit bundle endpoint: 
```
# fetch audit bundle (admin)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://private-admin.internal/customers/CUSTID/audit-bundle?since=2026-03-01 -o audit-bundle.tar.gz
```
KV-cache behavior unchanged, but monitor CPU during large bundle exports.

tess (security): Security checklist: customers requiring attestation must sign the new Compliance Attestation addendum before we flip FIPS-mode or telemetry toggles. Attestation template will be uploaded to the drive; Legal will co-sign. Also: telemetry sampling reduction to 0.1% is default for private, but customers can opt-in for verbose telemetry if they provide a contract addendum.

marta (support): I'll add the attestation column and start outreach tomorrow AM. We'll include the preflight curl and the audit-bundle GET example in the customer-facing checklist.

kevin (sales): Please tag customers who are enterprise and gov. I'll route contracts for attestation and the retention add-on.

patrick (prod): Quick preflight snippet customers can run if they self-host: 
```
# quick preflight (agent)
docker run --rm redwood/private-agent:2.2-beta preflight 
  --customer-id=CUST123 --check-fips --check-audit-endpoint
```
If it fails, capture the agent logs: `/var/log/redwood/agent.log` and open a support ticket with the bundle.

devon (eng-runtime): We'll push a short monitor that fires if export CPU > 70% for >5m and another alert for 99th pct tail latency deviation > 20% from baseline in first 24h post-rollout.

tess (security): One more thing: export-control flag retained — customers in restricted jurisdictions need legal sign-off before audit bundles are allowed to leave their VPC. We'll annotate the readiness sheet accordingly.

patrick (prod): Action items: Support - add attestation + FIPS columns and start outreach (@marta). Sales - tag and route contracts for attestation & retention add-on (@kevin). Eng - add diag snippet to runbook + create the two monitors (@devon). Security - upload signed attestation template and note export constraints (@tess). React with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll hold GA if blockers remain by Sun 23:59 UTC. Thanks everyone!
